attempts.summary: Configured node1 as the persistent OpenWrt gateway for trusted 192.168.50.0/24 and guest 192.168.60.0/24 networks. Both receive DHCP, DNS, and internet access. node2 serves “infraset-trusted” at app.home.test:8080; node4 can access it, while node3 is isolated. All four nodes passed sequential restart and recovery verification.
